_doc: v1.8.0c core + v1.8.0d format layer + v1.8.0e wide-vector layer fp golden-model validation — generated by scripts/fp_release_sweep.py against the SHIPPED include/generated fp artifacts (model-only sweeps, COMMIT 1 golden-before-RTL; RTL lockstep tests land with the respective RTL commits; the 0e sections rerun as golden/TB bit-equivalence at the 0e1/0e2 RTL gates).

frsqrt32.sweep: exhaustive 2^24 mantissa x binade-parity classes, shipped seed ROM
frsqrt32.measurement_note: float64 distance measurement error ~2^-28 ulp32 (sqrt and divide each correctly rounded in float64) — negligible vs the recorded margin; worst-1000 rechecked exactly (isqrt to 2^-60).

fdiv.internal_format: Q2.30 round-to-odd Newton reciprocal (3 iterations) + exact Markstein correction

cvt_widen_f16.oracle_exclusion: NaN payloads only — golden canonicalizes (sNaN quieted); both sides asserted NaN. Subnormals are IN the compare (exact on both sides).

cvt_widen_bf16.oracle_exclusions: NaN payloads (golden canonicalizes; both sides asserted NaN) and the 254 bf16-subnormal inputs (pinned signed-zero flush; oracle asserted to land in fp32-subnormal space, proving the splice-would-be-subnormal rationale).

i2f.oracle: numpy int64 -> float32 astype (hardware RNE cvt)

f2i.oracle: float64 rint (RNE) + clip + NaN->0 composition (independent of the Fraction-based golden path)

roundtrip_e_row.scope: normals/+-0/+-Inf/canonical-qNaN ONLY (re-scoped E-row); f16 subnormals fail by the FTZ pin, bf16 subnormals by the widen signed-zero pin — asserted, not ignored

fminmax_0e.semantics: frozen IEEE-2019 minimumNumber/maximumNumber, six pinned rows; comparator key a[31] ? ~a : a^0x80000000, ONE unsigned 32b compare; DATA functions only (the FSCALAR-clone legality re-row is decode-level)
fminmax_0e.oracle: independent exact-Fraction value-level compare, NO DAZ, -0<+0 tie rule (disjoint from the offset-key formulation)
fminmax_0e.daz_exempt_note: ref_fminmax operates on RAW bit patterns, never golden decode() — denormal cells returned bit-identically (pinned row 6)

dequant_0e.semantics: int4/int8 x fp32 broadcast scale -> bf16-ONLY (0e pin), ROUND-ONCE definition (a): one RNE from the exact <= 31-bit product (|k| <= 128 and m_s < 2^24 both fit the wide product exactly — nothing rounds before the single RNE-to-bf16)
dequant_0e.narrow_authority: ref reuses ref_narrow_f32 (THE single f32->bf16 authority) through a sticky-preserving round-to-odd 24-bit intermediate — bit-identity with the CVT narrow path by construction; micro is the independent OPS_DEQ disjoint-round/sticky bf16-pack twin
dequant_0e.scale_set: pinned 2^13: directed specials + all 256 exponent fields x both signs x {0,1,max,random} mantissas + fixed-seed random fill (seeds 0xDE05/0xDE08)

round_once_cells.note: MSE ratio is provably blind to round-once-vs-double-round; these cells are the enforcement point (golden now, golden/TB bit-equivalence at the 0e1 RTL commit)

dequant_0e.ftz_at_dest_vacuity: min nonzero |product| = 1 x 2^-126 = bf16 min-normal exactly (asserted 0x0080/0x8080) — the FTZ cell is pinned for the pack logic and unreachable from valid operands

gamma_mul_w_0e.semantics: out[i] = sext8(a4[i]) * sext8(g4[i]) — EXACT widening int4 x int4 -> int8, MU-hosted (0e1, pre-stable reallocation of the retired 0x6B code point)
gamma_mul_w_0e.int8_range_proof: products in [-56, +64] subset [-128, 127] — rounding-free AND saturation-free (measured over all 256 cells, matches the docstring proof: min (-8)*7 = -56, max (-8)*(-8) = +64)
gamma_mul_w_0e.lane_order: lane i = bits [8i+7:8i] of the 128b output (2 frags), pinned in spec + golden + SDK together
gamma_mul_w_0e.gamma_transport: imm64 XOR OPREF (legality rung, decode-level — not modeled by the DATA functions)

vfma_0e2.staging: 0x70 is a 0e2 op — golden authored NOW (golden-before-RTL), consumed by the 0e2 RTL commit
vfma_0e2.semantics: out[i] = (sext32(a[i]) * b_mul + c_acc) mod 2^32 EXPLICIT; STATELESS (acc bit = 1 marks the wide-acc OUTPUT form, not stateful accumulation)
vfma_0e2.b_split_pin: c_acc = B[63:32] broadcast int32; b_mul = sext32(B[3:0]) int4 / sext32(B[7:0]) int8; imm16/imm32 zero-fill -> c_acc = 0 (asm-lint loudly rejects out-of-range b_mul imm encodings — lint rule, not datapath)
vfma_0e2.oracle: independent int64 little-endian struct truncation (no shared mask code)
vfma_0e2.frag_note: int4 form = 16 fragments — the first consumer of the frag-FSM widening + Cluster frag_mask_full fix

lane_frag_packing_0e.pin: lane i at flat bits [lane_bits*i +: lane_bits]; fragment f = flat[64f +: 64] low-first; 16 int4 / 8 int8 / 4 bf16 / 2 int32-or-f32 lanes per 64b word (spec+golden+SDK pin; the '2 bf16/word' prose error is corrected to 4)

norm_mse_gate_0e1.gate: per-tensor MSE(chain, exact) / MSE(RNE_bf16(exact), exact) <= 1.05 (criterion 3, scoped bf16-out + RMSNORM end-to-end incl. per-lane gamma)
norm_mse_gate_0e1.reference: mpmath 192-bit exact, eps-INCLUSIVE: exact_i = gamma_i * x_i / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)
norm_mse_gate_0e1.chain: golden rmsnorm_chain_0e: L2SQ -> I2F -> FS_MUL(1/N fold) -> FS_ADD(eps) -> FRSQRT32 -> exact exponent folds -> 0x6B -> DEQUANT int8-16 bf16 (round-once)
norm_mse_gate_0e1.tensor_generation: pinned int4 lanes x per-tensor power-of-two fp32 scale, binades 2^-8..2^8; fixed int-lane distributions (a data-binade sweep alone quantizes to all-zero rows)
norm_mse_gate_0e1.gamma_convention: int4 gamma, implicit 2^-k (k=3 pinned, k=0 variants swept), folded into the DEQUANT scale as an exact exponent shift
norm_mse_gate_0e1.denominator_floor_rule: rows with empirical bf16 floor < 5% of the generic uniform-residual floor mean((ulp/2)^2)/3 use the absolute criterion MSE(chain) <= generic floor

round_once_enforcement.note: MSE ratio is provably blind to round-once-vs-double-round; these cells are the enforcement point (golden now, golden/TB bit-equivalence at the 0e1 RTL commit)

bit_identity_0x7C_eq_0x77: true by construction — one golden ref_narrow_f32 is the single authority called by both cvt(NARROW_FROM_F32) and store_quant; wiring pinned by 2x10^4 sampled assertions per format

independent_oracle_policy.rule: COMMIT-0 pin 13: golden narrow/widen/F2I cross-checked against independent oracles BEFORE golden becomes sole authority (guards the identically-wrong-shared-function hole)
oracles: numpy float16 (f16 widen exhaustive, narrow windows + 2^22 random)
ml_dtypes bfloat16 0.5.4 (bf16 widen exhaustive, narrow 2^22 random)
float64 frexp/rint value-level narrow formulation (every narrow point, unmasked)

documented_divergences_masked.ftz_at_f16_destination: (0, 2^-14) result band — golden flushes (pin 5, documented GPU divergence), numpy preserves f16 subnormals; masked rows asserted to flush to signed zero on the golden side
documented_divergences_masked.nan_payloads: golden canonicalizes every NaN (pins 1-2); oracles preserve/vary payloads; masked rows asserted NaN on BOTH sides
documented_divergences_masked.daz_bf16_narrow_inputs: fp32-subnormal sources — golden DAZ-flushes (pin 7); ml_dtypes rounds the 0x007FFF80-0x007FFFFF sliver up to bf16 min-normal 0x0080 (asserted: 128/128, proving DAZ is observable and live)
documented_divergences_masked.bf16_subnormal_widen: 254 inputs — golden flushes to signed zero (pin 6); oracle asserted to land in fp32-subnormal space (proving the splice rationale)
